_comment: Bundled offline recipe pool. Live APIs (TheMealDB / Spoonacular) are tried first; these cover cuisines those APIs barely or don't cover at all (Pacific islands, regional African, Latin American, etc.). Show a generic dish name + image via free CDN where possible. regions[] drives matching in src/offline.js.

recipes.name: Kokoda (Raw Fish in Coconut)
recipes.countryHint: Fiji, Samoa, Tonga, Cook Islands, Tuvalu
recipes.instructions: Dice the fish finely and marinate in lime juice until the flesh is 'cooked'. Add coconut milk, chilli, onion, tomato and coriander. Chill and serve cold.

recipes.name: Palusami (Taro Leaves in Coconut Cream)
recipes.instructions: Wilt taro leaves, stir in warm coconut cream and onion. Wrap portions in taro leaves to form parcels and bake or steam until tender.

recipes.name: Ota Ika
recipes.instructions: Marinate cubed raw fish in citrus juice. Toss with coconut milk, cucumber, tomato, chilli and onion. Serve chilled as a starter.

recipes.name: Cassava Cake (Kumala)
recipes.countryHint: Papua New Guinea, Solomon Islands, Fiji
recipes.instructions: Mix grated cassava with coconut milk, sugar, butter and egg. Bake until set and golden. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Poke-style Raw Fish (Nagasari)
recipes.countryHint: Hawaii-style, but a common island staple
recipes.instructions: Cube fresh tuna and toss with soy, sesame oil, onion, seaweed and chilli. Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Jollof Rice
recipes.instructions: Blend tomatoes, pepper and onion into a smooth paste. Fry, add stock and rice, cover and cook until the rice is steamed and smoky.

recipes.name: Groundnut/Peanut Stew (Mafé)
recipes.instructions: Braise the meat with onion and tomato, add stock and peanut butter, then simmer with root vegetables until thick and rich.

recipes.name: Okra Stew
recipes.instructions: Slice okra and simmer with meat, stock and seasoning until the soup turns silky and thick. Serve with fufu.

recipes.name: Egusi Soup
recipes.instructions: Toast egusi and whisk into palm oil with stock. Add meat, season, then fold in greens and simmer until thick.

recipes.name: Ugali and Sukuma Wiki
recipes.instructions: Make a stiff cornmeal porridge (ugali). Separately sauté collard greens with onion and tomato. Serve the greens alongside the ugali.

recipes.name: Doro Wat (Spicy Chicken Stew)
recipes.instructions: Slowly caramelise onion, add berbere and spiced butter, then braise chicken. Add boiled eggs and simmer until the sauce turns deep red.

recipes.name: Samosa
recipes.instructions: Fill pastry triangles with spiced mince, seal and deep-fry until golden and crisp.

recipes.name: Pepperpot (Guyana-Style Stew)
recipes.instructions: Brown the meat, add cassareep, spices and enough water to cover, then simmer slowly for hours until dark and velvety.

recipes.name: Callaloo
recipes.instructions: Simmer greens and okra in coconut milk with seasoning, then blend until smooth and thick. Finish with flaked fish or crab.

recipes.name: Empanadas
recipes.instructions: Fill pastry with seasoned beef, onion, olives and egg, fold into half-moons, seal and bake or fry until golden.

recipes.name: Ceviche
recipes.instructions: Marinate cubed fish in lime until barely cooked by the acid. Toss with onion, coriander and chilli. Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Arepas
recipes.instructions: Mix cornmeal with salted water to a soft dough, shape into rounds and cook on a hot griddle until crisp outside and fluffy inside.

recipes.name: Feijoada (Black Bean Stew)
recipes.instructions: Simmer black beans with smoked pork, garlic, onion and bay until thick. Serve with rice and an orange slice.

recipes.name: Kabsa (Spiced Rice and Chicken)
recipes.instructions: Braise chicken with onion, tomato and kabsa spices. Cook basmati rice in the rich stock and serve beneath the chicken.

recipes.name: Mansaf
recipes.instructions: Simmer lamb in a jameed-yogurt broth until tender. Layer rice and lamb on flatbread and pour the broth over, scattering pine nuts.

recipes.name: Khoresht Gheymeh (Yellow Split-Pea Stew)
recipes.instructions: Brown meat with onion, add split peas, tomato and dried lime; simmer until tender. Top with saffron and crispy potato chips.
